name: Microsoft DiskSpd
notes: Use file targets by default. Raw disk and partition write targets are forbidden.

name: smartmontools
notes: Windows release is extracted without installing from the official SourceForge project mirror. Read SMART/NVMe health only by default.

name: Prime95
notes: Keep outside the repository until redistribution terms are approved.

name: y-cruncher
notes: Use the command-line manual shipped with the selected release.

name: MemTest86+
notes: Requires external boot. Secure Boot compatibility must be checked before use.

name: OCCT
notes: Do not automate the personal GUI. CLI and structured reports require the appropriate license.

name: HWiNFO
license: free for non-commercial use; paid tiers available
notes: Portable package is obtained from SAC, a mirror linked by HWiNFO. HWiNFO64/ARM64 require a paid license for commercial use.

name: Display Driver Uninstaller
notes: Official self-extracting release is unpacked without execution. Run locally, preferably in Safe Mode, with recovery key and replacement driver ready.

name: AMD Cleanup Utility
notes: AMD-specific alternative that creates a restore point and recommends Safe Mode.

name: Intel Extreme Tuning Utility
notes: 7.x is for supported 14th Gen and older unlocked CPUs; 10.x is for supported Core Ultra Series 2 and newer.

name: AMD Ryzen Master
notes: Processor support and available tuning controls vary by generation and platform.

name: CPU-Z Portable
notes: Portable ZIP edition from CPUID. Capture CPU, mainboard, memory and SPD identity before tuning.

name: TechPowerUp GPU-Z
notes: Standalone official executable resolved through the official TechPowerUp mirror selector.

name: CrystalDiskInfo Portable
notes: Standard ZIP edition. Do not change vendor-specific drive controls during inspection.

name: CrystalDiskMark Portable
notes: Standard ZIP edition. It writes test data and can shorten flash-media life; begin with a small test size.

name: Microsoft Sysinternals Suite
notes: Official rolling ZIP snapshot. Includes both read-only diagnostics and system-changing utilities; launch tools individually.

name: Driver Store Explorer
notes: Portable GitHub release. Enumerating is safe; deleting driver packages requires an explicit recovery-aware workflow.

name: Fan Control
notes: Portable .NET 10 ZIP. Do not import or apply fan curves automatically; loss of cooling can damage stability results.

name: NirSoft BlueScreenView
notes: Official x64 portable ZIP for quick minidump triage; debugger confirmation is still required for root-cause claims.

name: NirSoft USBDeview
notes: Official x64 portable ZIP. Device removal/disable actions are blocked from automated profiles.

name: NirSoft FullEventLogView
notes: Official x64 portable ZIP for unified Windows event inspection and export.

name: Naraeon Dirty Test
notes: Measures SSD sustained write behavior while consuming broad free space. Back up first, select the correct volume, and expect heavy NAND writes. The author's download endpoint is HTTP, so the signed binary is SHA-256 pinned.

name: H2testw
notes: Writes and verifies files across selected free space. Best used on an empty, freshly formatted test volume; existing data must be backed up.

name: TrafficMonitor Lite
notes: Official x64 Lite release. Shows network throughput, CPU, RAM, GPU and disk use without the standard edition's deprecated temperature backend.

name: ZenTimings
notes: AMD-only detailed memory timings, clocks, voltages, SPD and supported DIMM telemetry. The official release checksum is pinned.

name: GRC ValiDrive
notes: Quickly spot-checks declared capacity of USB mass-storage devices. It complements, but does not replace, a full H2testw verification.

name: TestMem5 (anta777 profile)
notes: Memory overclock error detection using the anta777 Extreme1 profile. Requires administrator rights and a configuration load-and-restart step. Low-level memory access is frequently flagged by antivirus heuristics.

name: HCI MemTest (free)
notes: The free edition tests only unallocated RAM and has no command line or log file, so several instances must be started manually. Automated result capture requires the paid Pro edition and is intentionally not integrated.

name: LatencyMon
license: Home Edition free for personal use
notes: Measures DPC and ISR execution time to locate driver-induced audio dropouts, micro stutter and random pauses that sensor logging alone cannot explain.

name: NirSoft BatteryInfoView
notes: Reports designed versus full charge capacity, wear percentage and cycle count for notebook field checks.

name: WizTree Portable
notes: Reads the NTFS master file table directly, so free-space review before a dirty write test finishes in seconds. Deletion features stay manual and out of scope.

name: Ventoy
notes: Prepares the bootable USB medium that MemTest86+ requires. Installing Ventoy erases the target USB device, so it is never launched automatically.

name: Snappy Driver Installer Origin
notes: Detects missing or outdated drivers offline and can install them. Detection alone is read-only, but installation replaces drivers, so a restore point is required first. The bundled SDIO_auto.bat performs unattended installation and must never be used from this project.

name: SD Memory Card Formatter
license: Freeware; official SD Association EULA applies
notes: Official SD Association formatter for SD, SDHC and SDXC media. Formatting erases the selected card, so the tool is catalog-only, never auto-launched, and requires explicit confirmation. The bundled archive is version 5.0.4 from the official EULA download endpoint.

name: Glary Utilities Portable
notes: Maintenance suite used here for read-only inspection such as startup entries, disk analysis and system information. The package also ships registry cleaning, shredding, a boot-defragment kernel driver and background services; those write and cleanup features stay manual and are outside the supported scope.

name: Macrorit Partition Expert Free
notes: Official x64 portable ZIP. Free tier covers create, delete, format, resize, move and non-system MBR/GPT conversion with no paywalled apply step. GUI is launched for the operator only; this project never scripts partition writes. Binary is vendor-signed and SHA-256 pinned.

name: DiskGenius Free
notes: Official English portable ZIP. Advanced secondary tool: MBR/GPT repair, bad-sector scan and disk cloning. Powerful low-level operations are operator-driven only; recovery saves are paid-tier and out of scope. Never substitute cracked PartitionGuru builds; the vendor-signed binary is SHA-256 pinned.
